what: Jabbit hand review of ClinicalTrials.gov records on managing GLP-1 drugs around surgery, sedation and endoscopy
method: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 pulled 2026-10-19 12:20 EDT: every study listing semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, exenatide or retatrutide as an intervention, plus free-text searches for GLP-1 with anesthesia/sedation/endoscopy/perioperative/aspiration/residual-gastric terms and GLP-1 drugs with postoperative/infection/myocardial-injury/delirium terms; keyword-flagged records were read by hand and sorted. Counts are a lower bound: a study that names none of these words in its title, summary, arms or outcomes would be missed. Bariatric-surgery studies were not counted.
